_meta: A toy autoregressive sequence model, used to show teacher forcing versus free-running generation and the exposure bias between them. true_sequence is the ground-truth sequence the model was trained to produce; the true rule is simply next = current + 1. model_transition is the model's LEARNED next-token map, given the current token: it is correct everywhere (v -> v+1) EXCEPT at token 3, where it wrongly predicts 5 instead of 4 -- a single learned error. Under teacher forcing (training), each step is fed the true previous token, so the one error is isolated and the measured error rate is tiny. Under free-running generation (inference), each step is fed the model's OWN previous prediction, so once it emits the wrong 5 it keeps walking forward from 5, and every following token is off by one from the truth -- the single mistake cascades. The gap between the small teacher-forced error rate and the large generation error rate is exposure bias. true_sequence and model_transition are the fixture; every prediction, error, and cascade is computed.
